title: 第11章 晋级九阶武者第12章 巴雷特
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
看着王大年离去，叶凡的眸子凝重！
现代热武器，估计只能对付武皇之下，到了父亲叶峥嵘那种武宗境界，拥有护体罡气，刀枪不入，水火不侵！
面对武宗之上的武者，狙击枪也未必有用！
“只有自己的境界提升，才算真正的自保！”
突然，叶凡发现。
“怎么回事？我的境界，跌落了？”
他从六阶武者，居然跌到了三阶武者！
混沌万物鼎回答：“主人！你虽然境界跌落，但你没发现吗？你体内的武脉，从两条变成四条！”
“武脉的数量增加，内力被平摊下去，境界自然跌落了！”
叶凡果然感觉到，原本汹涌彭拜的任督二脉，一下子变成四条。
他修武的速度，也提升四倍！
修武不能急于一时，叶凡还是担心八姐，来到沈慕戎的房间。
花弄玉、花弄月姐妹守在伺候，屋外都是公爵府的甲士。
叶凡惊讶：“八姐，你怎么起来了？”
被一剑洞穿心脏的沈慕戎，已经下床，还在大快朵颐的吃完饭，手里一个鸡腿，要不是九姨娘沈虹劝说，她甚至想喝酒。
沈慕戎状态很好，完全看不出来受过伤：“我还要问你呢，小弟，你什么时候学的医术？”
“我都认为自己必死无疑，我娘说，你用了几根银针，就稳住我的伤势！”
叶凡心中更加惊讶。
混沌空间的石碑上介绍：鬼门十三针生死人、肉白骨。
可让心脉重生!可让断头重续！

叶凡认为这是一种夸张的说法，难道这是真的？
“混沌万物鼎！鬼门十三针如此恐怖？”
脑海中传来混沌万物鼎傲娇的声音：“哼！本鼎说过，这是万界最强医术，你以为开玩笑呢？”
叶凡上前，握住沈慕戎的手腕！
查探脉搏，确实很稳，健壮如牛。
“八姐，我要看看伤口。”
“嗯，你看吧。”
沈慕戎的俏脸一红，也不避讳，扒开自己的衣服。
叶凡低头看去，雪白的峰峦上有一道已经愈合的伤口。
伸手拨弄两下，肌肉已经愈合。
“鬼门十三针果然厉害！”
“小弟，你哪儿学的医术？”
叶凡随口解释：“几年前我遇到一个白胡子老者，他晚上来教我的！”
沈慕戎脸色微变，和沈虹对视一眼。
“小凡，戎儿说你能习武了？也是那个白胡子老者帮你的？”
“嗯。”
叶凡将错就错，混沌万物鼎的事太骇人听闻，是他最大的秘密！
任何人他都不准备说：“是的，他说我中了一种毒！”
content_en:
Watching Wang Danian leave, Mark's eyes were solemn!
Modern thermal weapons may only be able to deal with the Emperor Wu. Once he reaches the level of his father Ye Zhengrong, he possesses body-protecting aura and is invulnerable to swords and guns, as well as water and fire!
Facing warriors above the Wuzong, sniper rifles may not be useful!
"Only when your own realm improves can you truly protect yourself!"
Suddenly, Ye Fan discovered.
"What's going on? My level has fallen?"
He actually fell from a sixth-level warrior to a third-level warrior!
The Cauldron of Chaos All Things replied: "Master! Although your realm has fallen, haven't you noticed? The martial veins in your body have changed from two to four!"
"As the number of martial veins increases, the internal strength is spread evenly, and the realm naturally drops!"
Ye Fan really felt that the two veins of Ren and Du, which were originally surging and pengbai, suddenly turned into four.
The speed of his martial arts training also increased four times!
Xiuwu cannot be rushed. Ye Fan was still worried about the eighth sister and came to Shen Murong's room.
Sisters Hua Nongyu and Hua Nongyue were waiting, and outside the house were soldiers from the Duke's Palace.
Ye Fan was surprised: "Eighth sister, why are you up?"
Shen Murong, who had been pierced through the heart by a sword, had already gotten out of bed and was still finishing her meal with a chicken drumstick in her hand. If it weren't for the persuasion of Jiu Yiniang Shen Hong, she would even want to drink.
Shen Murong was in good condition and could not be seen injured at all: "I want to ask you, little brother, when did you learn medical skills?"
"I thought I was going to die, but my mother said you used a few silver needles to stabilize my injuries!"
Ye Fan was even more surprised.
The stone tablet in the Chaos Space introduces: The Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate contain the living and dead, flesh and white bones.
It can regenerate the heart! It can revive the severed head!
Ye Fan thinks this is an exaggeration. Is it true?
"Chaos Cauldron of All Things! Are the Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate so terrifying?"
The arrogant voice of the Chaos All Things Cauldron came from my mind: "Huh! This cauldron said that this is the most powerful medical skill in all worlds. Do you think you are joking?"
Ye Fan stepped forward and held Shen Murong's wrist!
I checked my pulse and it was indeed very steady, as strong as an ox.
"Eighth sister, I want to see the wound."
"Well, take a look."
Shen Murong's pretty face turned red, and he didn't shy away from taking off his clothes.
Ye Fan looked down and saw a healed wound on the snow-white peaks.
I reached out and fiddled with it twice, and the muscles had healed.
"The Thirteen Needles of the Ghost Gate are really powerful!"
"Brother, where did you learn medical skills?"
Ye Fan explained casually: "A few years ago I met an old man with a white beard, and he came to teach me at night!"
Shen Murong's expression changed slightly and he looked at Shen Hong.
"Xiao Fan, Rong'er said you can practice martial arts? Was it the old man with the white beard who helped you?"
"Yeah."
Ye Fan makes mistakes, the Chaos Cauldron of All Things is too shocking, it is his biggest secret!
He was not prepared to say to anyone: "Yes, he said I had a poison!"
